This criminal appeal under Section 14-A(2) of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act has been preferred by the appellant with the prayer to set aside the bail rejection order dated 06.07.2023 passed by learned Special Judge SC/ST (P.A. Act), Etah in Bail Application No. 1897 of 2023, arising out of Case Crime No. 88 of 2023, under Sections 376, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3 (2) 5 of SC/ST Act, Police Station Aliganj, District Etah.

sentences.text: As per the prosecution version, one Dalvir to whom the prosecutrix was having love affair had taken her mobile number and in turn he provided the mobile number of the prosecutrix to the appellant Manoj.

On 04.04.2023 at around 9 pm, appellant called the prosecutrix through phone to come to Manoj @ Pinku Yadav vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32370750/
1 the nearby road.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: When she reached the aforesaid place, after having some conversations in between them, appellant got her forcibly seated in his motorcycle which was driven by Sudhir.
They took her in a small room at his tubewell where she was raped by the appellant.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the appellant that appellant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
It is further submitted that prosecutrix is major and she was a consenting party.
In her statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. she admitted that she herself went to the appellant when she was called by him.
It is further submitted that during her medical examination no sign of sexual assault was observed which itself falsified the story of prosecution.

It is further submitted that there are material contradictions in the version of prosecution as referred in the F.I.R. and in the statements of the prosecutrix recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.

The appellant is languishing in jail since 31.05.2023 having no criminal history and in case he is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in the early disposal of the case.

Per contra, learned A.G.A. assisted by learned counsel for the informant vehemently opposed the prayer for bail contending that victim in her statements recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.
has consistently made allegation of committing rape against the present appellant.
Hence, the appeal is liable to be dismissed.

Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and and keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused,
severity of punishment and the fact that victim in her statements recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. made allegation of committing rape against the appellant, I do not find it fit case for bail.

Since the trial court has passed the impugned order after appreciating the evidence available on record, there is no occasion to interfere with the finding of fact recorded by the trial court, hence,
the present criminal appeal lacks merit and deserves to be dismissed.
Accordingly, the criminal appeal is dismissed.

However, the trial court is directed to expedite the trial and make every endeavour to record the statements of prosecution witnesses within a period of three months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order without granting any unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties subject to full co-operation by the appellant.

Order Date :- 18.9.2023 AKT  Manoj @ Pinku Yadav vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32370750/
